title: Maldives: Overwater Luxury Retreat
summary: A single-island stay built for doing very little, very well — a private overwater villa, a house reef, and dinners served on the sand.
highlights: A private overwater villa with direct lagoon access
Snorkeling the house reef at sunrise

itinerary.title: Arrive by seaplane
itinerary.description: A scenic seaplane transfer straight to your overwater villa.

itinerary.title: House reef
itinerary.description: Snorkeling at sunrise, then an open afternoon by your villa's plunge pool.

itinerary.title: Sandbank picnic
itinerary.description: A private boat to a sandbank for lunch, just the two of you.

itinerary.title: Spa day
itinerary.description: An overwater spa treatment, timed around the tide.

itinerary.title: Dolphin cruise
itinerary.description: An evening cruise, dolphins permitting, ending in a beach dinner.

itinerary.title: Depart
itinerary.description: A final morning swim before your seaplane transfer out.

included: 5 nights in a private overwater villa
Daily breakfast, 3 dinners including one on the sand
The sandbank picnic and spa treatment
A dedicated trip consultant, reachable throughout
